name: Masc-erade
source:
You're reluctantly going to a work event, but oops! You turned up at the wrong venue! Turns out this venue is double booked for both a masquerade ball and a rave where everyone wears homemade masks. You should leave and get to the work event... but there are too many hot women here!! You've got to stay and talk to a few of them!

[From [url=https://saeiken.itch.io/masc-erade]itch.io[/url]]
